thread:
ops-oncall: anyone seeing a spike in 5xxs from hosted inference for tenant acme-inc? several customer timeouts reported ~30s

sre-jamie: seeing it. gateway 504s align with new pods not reaching Ready. KEDA fired but pods stay Pending/Init for ~40-50s

eng-runtime-lina: can you paste the scaledobject + KEDA logs and any auth/billing errors around the window?

ops-oncall: snippet from cluster:
```
kubectl get scaledobject acme-inference -o yaml
spec:
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  pollingInterval: 30
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 10
triggers:
 - type: external
   metadata: ...
```

sre-jamie: cooldown=300s + poll=30s + min=0 = slow react. readiness probe for model-runtime also shows long init (model download + quantize step ~40-50s). that matches customer timeouts

eng-infra-raj: adding: auth service had 502/503s for token refresh during the same spike. some prewarm hooks attempt to pull weights from registry and fail when token creation is throttled -> blocks readiness

support-maya: customer timestamp: 2026-03-16T22:03:45Z first timeout. message: "app hung ~2m then 504"

eng-runtime-lina: quick repro: hammer endpoint with 100 concurrent short requests when cache cold -> queue backlog -> KEDA scales -> new pods schedule but model-init causes long Ready delay. KEDA settings + readiness semantics amplify the outage

ops-oncall: quick mitigation applied: bumped `minReplicaCount=1` for acme-inc and reduced `cooldownPeriod` to 60s. so far fewer 504s

billing-ana: billing team saw token-rotation spike causing transient 429->5xx to KMS. rolling a fix to avoid token bottleneck. ETA ~30m

sre-jamie: proposed permanent actions:
  - set `minReplicaCount >= 1` for bursty tenants
  - reduce `pollingInterval` to 10s and `cooldownPeriod` to 60s for scaledobjects serving production traffic
  - separate model-init readiness from app-liveness (avoid routing until model fetched)
  - implement async prewarm path that pulls model before routing traffic

eng-runtime-lina: I'll add a `prewarm=true` flag and change model fetch to use cached credential where possible to avoid auth path in init

deploy-bot: redeploy acme-inference-deployment@eng-runtime-lina started by @eng-runtime-lina

support-maya: runbook note: when triaging, collect `kubectl describe pod`, `kubectl logs -c model-init`, KEDA operator logs, gateway traces, and auth/token audit events. also capture `scaledobject` yaml and scaling events

ops-oncall: thanks all. monitoring the tenant now, will re-open thread if errors reappear :thumbsup:
